title: Independent C8 re-derivation, tiers A + B + C: assembly of the engine data (archive-free part)
note: Every number here comes from the project's own engine, framework, direct and spec components. No archive number was read or used by this script, which ran in a copy of the project without the sealed directories, under an audit hook. The claims under test are compared only afterwards (compare_archive_C8.py, ../RESULTS_C8_archive_comparison.json).
definition: C8 = 8 T4 = B_old + 4W + 2S + 3/4 U + 1/4 J9 + 3/32 L3 - 1/4 M21 + 1/2 M12 - 1/16 N2 + 1/8 Ndelta + 1/32 Kv (eq:C8assembly, derived in framework/derive_C8.py); B_done = B_old + 4W + 2S + 3/32 L3 - 1/4 M21 + 1/2 M12 - 1/16 N2; C8_asm = eq:C8assembly evaluated with our inputs (= 8 T4 up to the tree-data rounding)

meta.framework: framework/lri_framework.py Framework("C8", dps=50).from_replicates(strict=True, outputs=the 35 inputs, C3..C7, B_old8, B_done8, C8_asm, T4, C8, C8_partial)

tiers_ABC.note: tiers A + B + C merged per scalar by the engine (tests/merge_tiers_C8.py)

sigma_definitions.sigma_cov: linear propagation with the per-job replicate sample covariance / R, plus precision floors (framework sigma_linear)
sigma_definitions.sigma_rep: sd of the R=6 per-replicate assemblies / sqrt(R), plus floors (framework sigma_rep_total)
sigma_definitions.sigma_pool: sector-pooled projection of every job on the output gradient (pooled_errors.py), plus floors in quadrature
sigma_definitions.sigma_jobmax: reference only: per job the larger of its replicate and sector-pooled projection, summed in quadrature over jobs, plus floors (the engine budget_C8.py combination)
sigma_definitions.by_tier: error carried by the scalars of one tier alone (P = phase-2 production, A, B, C)

A7_d_1.definition: U package: A7_d_1 = [eps^0 l^1] d_delta A7

D_known.definition: U package: D_known = U - A7_d_1 (everything in U except A7_d_1)

EA5_d_0.definition: U package: (EE A5_d)_0 = [eps^0 l^0] d_delta E A5

EZ4_d_0.definition: U package: (EE Z4_d)_0 = [eps^0 l^0] d_delta E Z4

D_lower.definition: U package: D_lower = U - A7_d_1 + Z6_d_1 - 2 (EE A5_d)_0 + 2 (EE Z4_d)_0 (note l.1344-1347)

X_E.definition: Kv package: X_E = [eps^0 l^0] d_v E Q6

F3_known.definition: Kv package: F3_known = Kv + 4 P8 = 16 X_vv - 8 X_E + S3

S3.definition: Kv package: S3 = Kv + 4 P8 - 16 X_vv + 8 X_E (note l.1363-1366)

EA7_0.definition: J9 package: (EE A7)_0 = [eps^0 l^0] E A7

EZ6_0.definition: J9 package: (EE Z6)_0 = [eps^0 l^0] E Z6

D9_lower.definition: J9 package: D9_lower = J9 - A9_1 + Z8_1 - 2 (EE A7)_0 + 2 (EE Z6)_0 (note l.1388-1391)

C_fixed.definition: C_fixed = C8 + P6/2 (eq:C8short: C8 = C_fixed - P6/2)

C8_without_J9.definition: C8 - J9/4: C8 without its J9 term (the tier-B target quantity)

C8.note: per job: replicate (rep) and sector-pooled (pool) projections of the job on the gradient; max = the larger of the two; shares of sum(max^2). Tier P = phase-2 production.

C8_without_J9.note: per job: replicate (rep) and sector-pooled (pool) projections of the job on the gradient; max = the larger of the two; shares of sum(max^2). Tier P = phase-2 production.

U.note: per job: replicate (rep) and sector-pooled (pool) projections of the job on the gradient; max = the larger of the two; shares of sum(max^2). Tier P = phase-2 production.

Kv.note: per job: replicate (rep) and sector-pooled (pool) projections of the job on the gradient; max = the larger of the two; shares of sum(max^2). Tier P = phase-2 production.

J9.note: per job: replicate (rep) and sector-pooled (pool) projections of the job on the gradient; max = the larger of the two; shares of sum(max^2). Tier P = phase-2 production.

tierBC_vs_pilot_inputs.what: U, Kv, J9, C8 from production + tiers A, B, C minus the same with the tier-B/C scalars replaced by the pilots' all-sector values (c8val, c8conv, c8kplus1, poles1, kplus1; independent seeds) where they exist; sigma = the swapped scalars of both runs (linear, replicate covariance + floors)

heavy_jobs_vs_probe_and_conv_pilot.what: for each heavy job, the sum over the sector sample of the conv pilot (every S-th sector, offset S/2) of the production per-sector estimates vs an independent run on exactly those sectors: the probe (c8probeBC, planned production N) and the conv pilot (N = 1009, 4001; pre-asymptotic). Each side sum_s mean_r x_sr with variance sum_s var_r(x_sr)/R. Disjoint seeds (different tier names).

direct.window_probe_rule: phase-2 rule (assembly/direct_check.py): a verdict that flips, or a d0 that moves by more than its u0, under a change of eps_max (0.011, 0.016, 0.021, 0.051) is tail-model dependent

independence.code: no archive integration or evaluation code imported, called or copied (engine, framework, direct, spec and assembly are the project's own); no archived raw data (*_negative.json, *_audit.json, *.expr, P6/P8/U/J9/Kv expression files) used as input
independence.this_script: reads only the project's engine runs, framework, spec/out (archive-free part) and the direct table; it ran in a project copy on the personal desktop that contains neither spec/comparison*, nor the archive-comparison result files, nor the compendium, under a Python audit hook that aborts on any open of them (out/C8_ABC/audit_*.log)

compute.this_assembly: one personal-desktop Slurm job (see out/C8_ABC/slurm_*.out); framework assembly, validate_C8.py and direct_C8.py
